title: Get The Victoria’s Secret Model Look – Makeup Tutorial | Charlotte Tilbury
description:
Recreate the OFFICIAL Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show 2018 makeup straight from the catwalk with this tutorial for the show. Charlotte Tilbury wanted to create a fresh, natural, glamorous look that cast its spell over the iconic runway, including the thrilling return of two of her best-selling, limited edition eye products! 

Watch this makeup tutorial to discover how Charlotte Tilbury created this dreamy look that you can recreate at home.
